To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
an iterative narrowband-based graph cuts optimization for geodesic active contour with region forces is proposed to segment objects in real-world images.

we proposed an iterative narrowband-based graph-cuts method to optimize the geodasic active contours with region force (GACWFR) model, and the proposed method is similar to the Grab-cut method when the Gaussian-mixture model region force is used.
we propose a new method for interactive image segmentation, namely, INBGC, and an improved method, IINBGC, for interactive object segmentation by integrating region force into INBBGC method.

the following issues: (i) an INBBGC method to optimize the GCBAC model; (ii) the extension of INBBGC method into IINBBGC for GACWRF optimization; (iii) the analysis of the relationship between our proposed IINBGC method and other related algorithms.

the proposed IINBBG method can be regarded to be similar to GCBAC and narrow-band-based GrabCut method with region force, and can be applied to interactive object segmentation.
the proposed IINBBG method can effectively segment the object with complicated shape in a wide range of real-world images.
our IINBBGC with region force is a better algorithm than the GCBAC and the Grabcut methods for interactive object segmentation.
